app_intro: Practise your group's songs: the sheets and recordings from the shared folder, each song together, the recording slowed down as much as you need.
project_is: A project is one group you play with: a band, a choir, a course.
name: Name
link_hint: Whoever leads the group can copy it from OneDrive: Share → Copy link. You can add it later too.
stays_here: Everything stays in this browser: the files are saved on this device, nothing is sent anywhere else.
link_bad: That doesn't look like a OneDrive link.
saved_offline: The files are saved in this browser, so the songs play without a network later.
sign_in_once: OneDrive asks you to sign in once, with any Microsoft account, before it shows the shared folder.
only_reads: Downtempo only reads the folder. You come back here after signing in.
look_hint: Look in the shared folder to see which songs are there.
which_folders_from: Which folders do you need from {name}?
tick_hint: Tick the folders to download; a ticked folder brings everything inside it. Inside a ticked folder, click a folder to leave it out.
no_folders_top: There are no folders inside: the whole shared folder is used.
nothing_ticked: Nothing ticked: the whole shared folder.
update_title: Check the shared folders for new files
language_reloads: The page reloads in the chosen language.
language_wait: Wait for the download to finish first.
asks_again: OneDrive asks again after a day without use.

match.countPlural=one: Remove “{name}” and its {count} file from this device?
match.countPlural=other: Remove “{name}” and its {count} files from this device?

match.countPlural=one: {count} downloaded file is outside these folders. Remove it from this device?
match.countPlural=other: {count} downloaded files are outside these folders. Remove them from this device?

confirm_delete: Delete the project “{name}” for good? Its link, chosen folders, downloaded files, loops, regions and everything remembered go. The shared folders on OneDrive aren't touched.
device_all: This browser holds {used} of Downtempo's files and allows up to {allowed}.
kept: The files are kept: the browser won't clear them by itself, even when the disk runs full.
may_clear: The browser may clear the files by itself when the disk runs full. Keep files asks it not to.
cant_play_file: This browser can't play the file.
click_first: The browser wants a click first: press ▶.
file_gone: The file isn't on this device any more: press ⟳ Update.

match.countPlural=one: {count} no longer in the shared folder (kept here)
match.countPlural=other: {count} no longer in the shared folder (kept here)

stopped: Stopped. The files that finished are kept.
signin_mismatch: The sign-in answer doesn't match this tab; please sign in again.
signin_asks: OneDrive asks to sign in again.
link_is_file: The link opens a file, not a folder.
cant_save: This browser can't save files here (no createWritable).
hear_end_title: Play the last 2 s and the jump back to the start
editor_hint: Click, click or drag to select · wheel zooms · a click on the time ruler seeks
click_end: Click to set the end · Esc cancels
no_saved: No regions yet: set a loop and save it.
fit_page: Fit page: the whole page in view (H)
open_pdf: Open the PDF in a new tab
key_full: full screen: only the sheet (Esc back)
leave_out: Click to leave this folder out of the download
take_back: Click to download this folder after all
ask_name: What do you call this group?
delete_files_hint: Removes the downloaded files from this device and frees {size}. The project, its folders and your loops stay; ⟳ downloads the files again.
confirm_delete_files: Delete {files} of “{name}” ({size}) from this device? The project, its folders and your loops stay; ⟳ downloads the files again.
delete_project_hint: Removes the project from the menu with its link, folders, files, loops and everything remembered.
unkeep_hint: This can't be undone here: clearing this site's data in the browser's settings removes both the files and the keeping.
sheet_only_hint: Tap the sides to turn, the middle for this bar
about_intro: Practise your group's songs: the sheet and the recording together, the recording slowed down with its pitch kept.
about_demo: This online version is a demonstration. For regular or wide use, please run your own copy: the source code is open on GitHub.
about_signin: You sign in on Microsoft's own sign-in page. Downtempo never sees your password.
about_kept: The sign-in is kept only in this browser, on this device.
about_reads: Downtempo opens only the shared folders you add, and only reads them. Microsoft asks permission to read and write your OneDrive, because a personal account needs it to open a shared link; Downtempo writes nothing there.
about_copies: The files are copied only into this browser's own storage, on this device.
about_no_server: There is no Downtempo server. The app talks only to Microsoft, for the sign-in and your files; nothing you open, play or set is sent anywhere else, and nothing is tracked.
about_remove: In Settings, Delete the project removes its files from this device, and Sign out ends the sign-in. Clearing this site's data in your browser removes everything.
